PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (16.0, 12.0, 20.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.8, 0.3, 1.5),        # input pair L
    "gmid3": (9.0, 6.0, 13.0),       # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "L3":    (0.8, 0.4, 1.5),        # PMOS mirror load L
    "itail": (70e-6, 50e-6, 80e-6),  # tail current
    "gmidt": (13.0, 9.0, 16.0),      # tail / bias mirror gm/Id (low vdsat for headroom)
    "Lt":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # tail / bias mirror L
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    itail = p["itail"]
    i1 = itail / 2.0

    # input pair (source near 0.25 V -> vsb ~0.25)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.6, vsb=0.25)
    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], i1, vds=0.6)
    m3d = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], i1, vds=m3.vgs)
    # bias: diode sinks iref, tail mirrors it with ratio itail/iref
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], iref, vds=0.6)
    mbd = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], iref, vds=mb.vgs)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], itail, vds=0.25)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mbd)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # vinp -> M2 side drives vout (non-inverting); vinn -> M1 side is the diode side
    n.dev("M1", "nd", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "nd", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3d)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)

    # ---- analytic predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    gout = m1.gds + m3.gds
    a0 = gm1 / gout
    cout = cl + m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m3.cgd
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cout)
    cmir = 2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    fp2 = m3.gm / (2 * PI * cmir)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fp2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * fp2)))
    slew = itail / cout
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    noise_th = math.sqrt(16 * kT / (3 * gm1) * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    noise_1k = 4 * noise_th  # flicker dominated estimate
    swing = (1.8 - (m3.vdsat + 0.1)) - (0.9 - m1.vgs + m1.vdsat + 0.1)
    gtail = mt.gds
    cmrr = 2 * gm1 * m3.gm / (gtail * gout) / max(a0, 1) if gtail > 0 else 1e4
    cmrr_db = db(max(cmrr * a0 / a0, 1.0)) if False else db(2 * m3.gm / gtail) if gtail > 0 else 80
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = 0.3 / slew + 4.6 * tau * 1.2
    power = 1.8 * (iref + itail)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(a0),
        "ugbw": ugbw,
        "pm": pm,
        "slew": slew,
        "noise_1k": noise_1k,
        "swing": swing,
        "cmrr_db": cmrr_db,
        "psrr_db": db(a0),
        "settle": settle,
        "power": power,
    }
